summary_cn: 一名49岁斯里兰卡籍男子涉嫌刺杀一名女性后骑摩托车逃离警方追捕。在逃离过程中恰好冲撞出森林的野象，导致摩托失控。民众和警察随后赶至现场，成功将其抓获。此事件提醒在泰人士需注意人身安全与交通安全。

title: Big C owner to shutter 12 subpar locations
desc: Berli Jucker (BJC), the operator of Big C, plans to close 12 underperforming stores by year-end as part of efforts to optimise its store portfolio, while stepping up renovations and selective expansion.
title_cn: Big C 超市母公司计划年底前关闭12家低效门店
summary_cn: Berli Jucker 公司（Big C 超市运营商）将在年底前关闭12家业绩不佳的门店，以优化整体店铺组合。同时公司加大门店装修投入，并在精选地点进行战略性扩张，以提升市场竞争力。
desc_original: Berli Jucker (BJC), the operator of Big C, plans to close 12 underperforming stores by year-end as part of efforts to optimise its store portfolio, while stepping up renovations and selective expansion.

title: Pulmonary disease fight stepped up
desc: Medical experts have called for stronger efforts to prevent and detect chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) in Thailand, warning of rising e-cigarette use alongside continued exposure to tobacco smoke and air pollution.
title_cn: 泰国医学界呼吁加强慢阻肺防控
summary_cn: 医学专家警示泰国慢性阻塞性肺病(COPD)防控形势严峻，呼吁加强预防与早期检测工作。电子烟使用增加、烟草烟雾持续暴露及空气污染恶化，成为该疾病高发的主要推手，威胁公众健康。
desc_original: Medical experts have called for stronger efforts to prevent and detect chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) in Thailand, warning of rising e-cigarette use alongside continued exposure to tobacco smoke and air pollution.

title: Speaker Sophon denies stalling Saksayam petition
desc: House Speaker Sophon Zarum brushed aside an opposition threat to take legal action against him over a delay in referring a petition concerning former transport minister Saksayam Chidchob to the Supreme Court.
title_cn: 众议院议长否认延迟处理请愿书指控
summary_cn: 众议院议长斯蓬·查鲁姆驳斥反对党指控，否认刻意延迟将前交通部长萨克萨亚姆·齐德乔布相关请愿书提交最高法院。反对党曾威胁对此采取法律行动，双方就程序问题产生分歧。
desc_original: House Speaker Sophon Zarum brushed aside an opposition threat to take legal action against him over a delay in referring a petition concerning former transport minister Saksayam Chidchob to the Supreme Court.

title: Princess's royal funeral set for Feb 1-5
desc: The royal cremation ceremonies for Her Royal Highness Princess Bajrakitiyabha Narendiradebyavati are scheduled to take place on Feb 1-5. The programme, published on the Phra Lan Facebook page yesterday, outlines the plan.
title_cn: 皇姬巴功王妃皇家火葬仪式定于2月举行
summary_cn: 皇姬巴功王妃(Princess Bajrakitiyabha Narendiradebyavati)的皇家火葬仪式定于2月1日至5日举行。火葬日程已由 Phra Lan 官方脸书账号公布，为期五天的仪式将按计划进行。
desc_original: The royal cremation ceremonies for Her Royal Highness Princess Bajrakitiyabha Narendiradebyavati are scheduled to take place on Feb 1-5. The programme, published on the Phra Lan Facebook page yesterday, outlines the plan.

title: SAO wants 260k baht for car use
desc: The State Audit Office (SAO) has found that executives of the Thai Public Broadcasting Service (Thai PBS) used the organisation's pool vehicles as if they were individually assigned cars despite already receiving vehicle allowances.
title_cn: 监察局查出泰国公共电视台挪用公车26万铢
summary_cn: 国家审计办公室(SAO)查证泰国公共电视台(Thai PBS)高管违规使用公务车池，将其当作个人专用车辆，尽管已领取车辆津贴，涉及金额约26万铢。此事件反映出公共机构管理漏洞。
desc_original: The State Audit Office (SAO) has found that executives of the Thai Public Broadcasting Service (Thai PBS) used the organisation's pool vehicles as if they were individually assigned cars despite already receiving vehicle allowances.

title: Zhao urges baht-backed stablecoin
desc: Thailand should develop a baht-backed stablecoin to expand the currency's international use as finance shifts to digital platforms, despite nascent regulations and mounting cybersecurity threats worldwide, said Changpeng Zhao, co-founder of Binance.
title_cn: 赵长鹏建议泰国开发泰铢支持的稳定币
summary_cn: 币安联合创始人赵长鹏（Changpeng Zhao）敦促泰国开发以泰铢为支撑的稳定币，以扩大泰铢在数字金融时代的国际用途。尽管相关监管仍在起步阶段、全球面临网络安全威胁，但数字货币已成必然趋势，有利于提升泰铢的国际竞争力。
desc_original: Thailand should develop a baht-backed stablecoin to expand the currency's international use as finance shifts to digital platforms, despite nascent regulations and mounting cybersecurity threats worldwide, said Changpeng Zhao, co-founder of Binance.

title: Settlement sought by 2028
desc: Kuala Lumpur: Thailand is hopeful its maritime dispute with Cambodia can be resolved before it assumes the Asean chairmanship in 2028, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said.
title_cn: 泰柬海事争端力争2028年前解决
summary_cn: 泰国副总理兼外交部长西哈萨克·邦凯都（Sihasak Phuangketkeow）在吉隆坡表示，泰国希望在2028年担任东盟主席国之前解决与柬埔寨的海事争端。这一目标反映了泰国对区域稳定和东盟一体化的高度重视，也为两国关系改善奠定基础。
desc_original: Kuala Lumpur: Thailand is hopeful its maritime dispute with Cambodia can be resolved before it assumes the Asean chairmanship in 2028, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said.

title: Thailand's exports increase at fastest rate in 5 years
desc: Exports surged by 27.5% year-on-year in ‌October, the fastest growth in five years, according to the Trade Policy and Strategy Office (TPSO).
title_cn: 泰国出口增速创五年新高
summary_cn: 根据泰国贸易政策和战略办公室（TPSO）发布的数据，十月份出口同比增长27.5%，创下过去五年来的最快增速。这一强劲增长反映了泰国出口竞争力的显著回升，以及国际市场需求改善，预示经济增长动力加强。
desc_original: Exports surged by 27.5% year-on-year in ‌October, the fastest growth in five years, according to the Trade Policy and Strategy Office (TPSO).

title: Norse suspension raises broader airline concerns
desc: The abrupt suspension of Norse Atlantic Airways' operations in Europe is affecting Thailand's tourism sector during the peak travel season, according to the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT), while tourism operators have expressed concern that other airlines with fragile financial positions could face similar difficulties.
title_cn: 北欧航空停运引发航企连锁风险
summary_cn: 北欧航空（Norse Atlantic Airways）在欧洲的突然停运正冲击泰国旅游旺季。据泰国旅游局（TAT）通报，旅游业界普遍担忧其他财务脆弱的航空公司可能面临类似困境。这一事件凸显疫后国际航企复苏的脆弱性，对赴泰外国游客的行程规划造成不确定性。
desc_original: The abrupt suspension of Norse Atlantic Airways' operations in Europe is affecting Thailand's tourism sector during the peak travel season, according to the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT), while tourism operators have expressed concern that other airlines with fragile financial positions could face similar difficulties.

title: A closer look at US-Thai trade relations
desc: Thailand-US trade relations have been under the spotlight since US President Donald Trump announced reciprocal tariffs on April 2, 2025. The move sparked concerns among Thai exporters and businesses over its impact on trade and competitiveness.
title_cn: 美泰贸易关系深层观察
summary_cn: 自2025年4月2日美国总统特朗普（Donald Trump）宣布实施互惠关税以来，泰美贸易关系备受关注。该举措引发泰国出口商和企业的广泛担忧，对关税对两国贸易和国际竞争力的影响表示忧虑，可能影响在泰经营的美资企业。
desc_original: Thailand-US trade relations have been under the spotlight since US President Donald Trump announced reciprocal tariffs on April 2, 2025. The move sparked concerns among Thai exporters and businesses over its impact on trade and competitiveness.

title: Startup doubts state goal of 1m solar installations
desc: Thailand's ambitious rooftop solar scheme, which aims to install solar panels on 1 million homes, is unlikely to meet its target by the September 2027 deadline unless policymakers address several key obstacles, according to clean energy startup ION Energy.
title_cn: 泰国初创公司质疑百万户屋顶太阳能装机目标
summary_cn: 泰国清洁能源初创公司 ION Energy 认为，政府 100 万户屋顶太阳能装机项目难以在 2027 年 9 月前达成目标。公司指出，除非政策制定者解决关键障碍，否则这一雄心勃勃的计划可能无法按期完成。该项目是泰国推进可再生能源和绿色能源转型的重要举措。
desc_original: Thailand's ambitious rooftop solar scheme, which aims to install solar panels on 1 million homes, is unlikely to meet its target by the September 2027 deadline unless policymakers address several key obstacles, according to clean energy startup ION Energy.

title: Distributors shrug off Nvidia chip ban
desc: Ingram Micro (Thailand), an authorised Nvidia distributor, has dismissed concerns over potential disruptions to AI server supplies following media reports that Nvidia had halted shipments to four Southeast Asian countries, including Thailand.
title_cn: 英伟达芯片禁运，泰国经销商对供应淡定
summary_cn: 美国芯片商英伟达被报道停止向泰国等四个东南亚国家供货，但英伟达授权经销商 Ingram Micro 泰国公司表示不担忧 AI 服务器供应中断。该公司认为此举对本地业务影响有限，对禁运措施保持相对淡定的态度。
desc_original: Ingram Micro (Thailand), an authorised Nvidia distributor, has dismissed concerns over potential disruptions to AI server supplies following media reports that Nvidia had halted shipments to four Southeast Asian countries, including Thailand.

title: Thailand foreign tourist arrivals fall 12% in October as exports grow
desc: Thailand foreign tourist arrivals fall 12% in October as exports grow Legacy Foreign tourist arrivals in Thailand fell 12% year on year to 2.27 million in October, the Finance Ministry’s Fiscal Policy Office (FPO) said in its economic report for the month, while exports grew 27.5%. Arrivals rose 4.5% from September, and the office listed US trade policy and conflict in the Middle East as risks to the Thai economy. FPO deputy spokesperson Pann Ananapibut said domestic travel kept growing while foreign arrivals were still slowing. Thai visitors made 23.3 million trips in October, up 0.4% on October last year and 0.6% on September. China, Thailand’s largest source market, was one of the weak spots in October. TAT figures showed Chinese arrivals fell 13.6% year on year to 308,942 , in a month when the Chinese Embassy issued a safety advisory to its citizens and flooding hit Bangkok. Photo courtesy of Prachachat Private consumption grew more slowly than a year earlier, the FPO said, although new car registrations rose 19.5% and new motorcycle registrations rose 3.3% year on year. Farmers’ real income rose 12.8%, while the consumer confidence index fell to 50.9 from 52.
title_cn: 十月赴泰外国游客同比下滑，出口增速强劲
summary_cn: 泰国财政政策办公室数据显示，10 月外国游客同比下降 12% 至 227 万人次，环比上升 4.5%。尽管出口强劲增长 27.5%，但中国游客（泰国最大客源）跌幅最大，同比下降 13.6% 至约 31 万人。国内旅游保持增长，外国游客下滑主要源于美国贸易政策和中东冲突等风险因素。

title: Panel targets toxic threats
desc: The Pollution Control Committee yesterday approved measures to strengthen efforts to address heavy metal contamination in risk areas along the Kok, Sai and Ruak rivers in Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai.
title_cn: 泰国加强清迈清莱河流重金属污染治理
summary_cn: 泰国污染控制委员会批准新措施，加强对清迈和清莱 Kok 河、Sai 河、Ruak 河等风险区域的重金属污染治理。这些措施旨在保护河流生态和当地饮用水安全。重金属污染长期威胁该地区环境和公众健康。
desc_original: The Pollution Control Committee yesterday approved measures to strengthen efforts to address heavy metal contamination in risk areas along the Kok, Sai and Ruak rivers in Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai.

title: Export surge fuels growth in October
desc: Thailand's economy continued to benefit from robust export growth and resilient domestic tourism in October, despite slowing private consumption, stagnant investment and declining foreign tourist arrivals, the Fiscal Policy Office (FPO) says.
title_cn: 十月泰国经济增长动力充足，出口与内需齐驱
summary_cn: 泰国财政政策办公室称，10 月经济继续受益于强劲出口和韧性十足的国内旅游支撑。尽管私人消费增速放缓、投资停滞、外国游客同比下降，但出口增长仍为经济提供主要动力。国内旅游持续发展为经济运行提供重要支持。
desc_original: Thailand's economy continued to benefit from robust export growth and resilient domestic tourism in October, despite slowing private consumption, stagnant investment and declining foreign tourist arrivals, the Fiscal Policy Office (FPO) says.

title: Engineers eye flyover reopening
desc: The Ratchaphruek interchange flyover on the outbound side of Ratchaphruek Road could reopen to traffic in just over a month, the Thailand Structural Engineers Association said after inspecting it yesterday.
title_cn: 拉差普鲁克立交桥 Ratchaphruek 有望一个多月后重开
summary_cn: 泰国结构工程师协会日前视察评估了拉差普鲁克路出站方向的立交桥，认为可在一个多月内重新开放交通。这项曼谷重要基建工程的完成将显著缓解该交通走廊的压力。
desc_original: The Ratchaphruek interchange flyover on the outbound side of Ratchaphruek Road could reopen to traffic in just over a month, the Thailand Structural Engineers Association said after inspecting it yesterday.

title: Court backs pilot intake review
desc: The Supreme Administrative Court has upheld a lower court ruling ordering the Royal Thai Air Force (RTAF) to recalculate the rankings of applicants for its 2024 pilot cadet intake following a dispute over eyesight testing criteria, according to one of the plaintiffs.
title_cn: 法院支持皇家泰国空军重新复审飞行员招录
summary_cn: 泰国最高行政法院维持下级法院裁决，要求皇家泰国空军（RTAF）根据眼力测试标准争议，重新计算2024年飞行员培训班申请者的排名。此案涉及招生程序的公平性与透明度。
desc_original: The Supreme Administrative Court has upheld a lower court ruling ordering the Royal Thai Air Force (RTAF) to recalculate the rankings of applicants for its 2024 pilot cadet intake following a dispute over eyesight testing criteria, according to one of the plaintiffs.

title: SET valuations attractive
desc: Thai shares could stage a gradual recovery in December as the recent pullback brought valuations on the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) back to more attractive levels.
title_cn: 泰国证交所股票估值回升至吸引水位
summary_cn: 泰国股市近期调整使泰国证券交易所（SET）的估值水平重回吸引力区间。分析人士预期12月份股市可能迎来逐步反弹，为投资者提供更优的入市时机。
desc_original: Thai shares could stage a gradual recovery in December as the recent pullback brought valuations on the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) back to more attractive levels.

title: Thailand weather today, 28 November: heavy rain in 14 provinces
desc: Thailand weather today, 28 November: heavy rain in 14 provinces Legacy The Thai Meteorological Department forecasts heavy rain in 14 provinces today. The southern region is hit hardest on both coasts. Nakhon Si Thammarat and Surat Thani face very heavy rain. Bangkok sees partly cloudy skies with temperatures down 1-2°C, ranging from 24 to 35°C. Authorities warn of flash floods, overflows and landslides near waterways and foothills in the southern provinces. People along the south east coast should beware of inshore surges. An active low-pressure cell is expected to move into the lower South during 29-30 November, bringing further rain to the region. A strengthening northeast monsoon over the Gulf, the South and the Andaman Sea is driving the wet conditions. Meanwhile a high-pressure system from China is pushing cooler, windier weather across upper Thailand. Bangkok Bangkok remains partly cloudy today. Lows of 24-26°C and highs of 33-35°C are expected, with temperatures down 1-2°C from previous days. Northeasterly winds of 10 to 20km/h are forecast. desc: The Supreme Administrative Court has rejected a request by the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) selection panel to suspend NBTC chairman Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck, pending the upper court’s final ruling in a dispute over his qualifications.

summary_cn: 泰国环保部正采取积极行动解决河流污染问题。该部门准备向国家环保委员会提议，将美功河(Khon River)、赛河(Sai River)、罗克河(Rok River)沿岸地区划定为污染控制区，对该区域内的钢铁、铝、铜等金属废料进出口实施严格管制。这一举措旨在防止工业污染进一步加剧河流质量恶化，保护区域水资源和生态环境。

title_cn: 曼谷电铁票价对比：「17-45泰铢」VS「40泰铢全天」哪个更划算
summary_cn: 关于曼谷电铁新票价制度的核心要点不在于注册速度的快慢，而在于消费者需要准确计算自己的常用出行路线。用户应根据日常使用频率和出行距离，在分段票价(17-45泰铢)和全天票(40泰铢)之间进行对比，选择更适合自己日常出行需求、更省钱的票价方案。建议消费者提前规划出行路线，以获得最大的经济效益。

title: Social Security poll winner to challenge disqualification
desc: Thanapong Chuamuangphan has vowed to challenge his disqualification from the Social Security Board in the Administrative Court, saying he was never given an opportunity to defend himself and did not even know who filed the complaint against him.
title_cn: 社会保障委员会选举获胜者将挑战撤销资格决定
summary_cn: 社会保障委员会选举获胜者丹那朋·丘阿蒙班(Thanapong Chuamuangphan)誓言在行政法院对其遭撤销的委员会资格一事提出异议。他强烈抗议撤销决定程序的不公正，声称从未被给予任何辩护机会，甚至不知道投诉人的身份。他认为这一程序违反了基本的法律程序，计划通过行政法院挑战这一决定。
desc_original: Thanapong Chuamuangphan has vowed to challenge his disqualification from the Social Security Board in the Administrative Court, saying he was never given an opportunity to defend himself and did not even know who filed the complaint against him.

title: Nakhon Ratchasima on influenza alert
desc: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - Doctors in this northeastern province are on alert as Nakhon Ratchasima accounts for almost one-third of all influenza deaths recorded  in Thailand so far this year.

summary_cn: 泰国东北部那空叻差府医疗部门已启动流感警报。该府今年的流感死亡病例占全国总数近三分之一，形势严峻，医疗机构需高度警备。

title: Norse Atlantic halts all flights, may file for bankruptcy
desc: Norse Atlantic halts all flights, may file for bankruptcy Legacy Norse Atlantic Airways, the Norwegian budget long-haul airline, suspended all its flights yesterday , November 26, leaving passengers stranded at airports in Thailand, Britain, South Africa and Florida. Its board said it intends to file for bankruptcy unless it secures urgent short-term financing, and the airline has given no date for flights to restart. Norse flew between London Gatwick and Bangkok four times a week and linked Oslo and Stockholm with both Bangkok and Phuket , and Avinor listed today’s Oslo to Phuket flight as cancelled, ScandAsia reported. A Gatwick to Phuket service had been due to start on December 4. The carrier built up its Thailand network over the past year, launching Stockholm to Bangkok and Gatwick to Bangkok flights in October 2025, as The Thaiger reported when Norse Atlantic announced its new Thailand routes and cut several US services. Yahoo Travel reported that around 2,500 British passengers were believed to be booked on Norse flights home, and Norse has not disclosed how many of its passengers are stranded in Thailand. title: BRISA Patong by Sansiri nears sell-out with over 90% reserved on day one
desc: BRISA Patong by Sansiri nears sell-out with over 90% reserved on day one Legacy BRISA Patong by Sansiri, the latest condo in the sub-district from developer Sansiri, had more than 90% reserved on the first day of sales, according to the company. The low-rise development was close to selling out by the end of that day. Thai and international buyers arrived from morning to evening on the opening day to secure their reservations. The response was strong enough to leave the project on the verge of a sell-out within its first day. The company says the demand reflects buyers’ confidence in the Sansiri brand and in the development’s location on Patong Sai 3 Road. The site is 350 metres from Jungceylon Shopping Centre and 900 metres from Patong Beach, a combination that appeals to both holiday buyers and investors. Starting prices range from 3.9 million baht to 13.9 million baht.* Only a limited number of units remain, and the team is encouraging anyone interested to reserve before the development sells out. For more information, call 1685 or add Sansiri on LINE . Project details Category Details Project name BRISA Patong by Sansiri Developer Sansiri Public Company Limited Location Patong

title: Chiang Mai airport sets daily record of 41,136 passengers after Yi Peng
desc: Chiang Mai airport sets daily record of 41,136 passengers after Yi Peng Legacy Chiang Mai International Airport handled 41,136 passengers on 279 flights yesterday, November 26, its busiest day since it opened, as visitors left the city after the Yi Peng festival. The airport expects the crowds to continue this weekend and has asked passengers to arrive at least two hours before domestic flights and three hours before international ones. Acting airport director Sakan Udon said the total beat the previous daily record of 40,888 passengers and 267 flights, set on January 25, 2019. Of the 279 flights on November 26, 212 were domestic and 67 were international. Photo: AP Photo/Lindsey Wasson The airport handled 144,974 passengers over the four days of the festival, from November 23 to 26, about 17% more than during Yi Peng last year, while the number of flights rose by about 22%. Arrivals made up most of the 36,877 passengers on November 23, and the peak on the last day came as tourists and residents travelled home. title: The Mall Korat expected to close after 2 billion lease negotiations collapse
desc: The Mall Korat expected to close after 2 billion lease negotiations collapse Legacy The Mall Korat is expected to close when its land lease ends on 19 January, after the group decided against renewing either of the two plots the shopping centre stands on. A source at The Mall Group gave the decision to Thai media on Friday. The main site is about 52 rai in two pieces with two owners, with roughly another 30 rai behind it for parking and support space. The Chuetchai family holds 32 rai, and the Kiattipinyochai family, known as the Thep Nakhon group, holds the 20 rai fronting Mittraphap Road. The 20 rai is where the talks broke down. The owners wanted more than 4,800 million baht for a 30 year lease, cut to about 2,000 million baht at a meeting on 19 November, and the group still judged it too high. Renewing meant about 1,000 million baht of new investment on top of the rent, a source said last month, to refurbish the existing building and extend the floor area, with a renewal fee on top of that. The 32 rai looked settled. The Mall Group and the Chuetchai family agreed a memorandum to extend that lease by 30 years from 19 July 2026, with the contract reported at more than 1,000 milli

title: Chiang Mai clears 36 tonnes of krathong waste from Ping River
desc: Chiang Mai clears 36 tonnes of krathong waste from Ping River Legacy Chiang Mai officials began removing about 36 tonnes of krathong waste from the Ping River today, November 27, after the floats released during the Yi Peng festival drifted downstream and piled up against a water gate . Officials warned that the waste, equal to roughly 50,000 krathongs, would foul the water, block the river’s flow and harm its ecosystem if left in place. The floats gathered at the water gate in Pa Daet subdistrict, Mueang Chiang Mai district, after residents and tourists set them on the river during the festival earlier this week, along with other rubbish that collected at the same point. Chiang Mai Deputy Governor Siwakorn Buapong opened the annual clean-up at the gate, which brought together provincial agencies, local administrations, village heads, private companies and residents. Siwakorn said the Ping River has supported the livelihoods, economy and farming of Chiang Mai people for generations. He added that Yi Peng is a valuable part of the province’s cultural heritage, and that restoring the river once the festival ends is a duty shared by everyone. Photo: AP Photo/Lindsey Wasson
title_cn: 清迈 Chiang Mai 清理平河 Ping River 36 吨水灯节废弃物
summary_cn: 清迈当局于11月27日清理平河中的水灯节废弃物，共约36吨，相当于5万个水灯。这些废物堆积在帕达 Pa Daet 社区的水闸处，若不清理会污染水质、阻塞河流。副省长西瓦空 Siwakorn Buapong 主持清理启动仪式，参与者包括省级部门、地方行政、村长和企业代表，体现全社会共同保护河流生态和文化遗产的责任。
